recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, spherical cluster of stylized 3D objects and characters floating in a star-filled black void. The composition features two central cartoonish male heads with sunglasses, surrounded by a miniature world containing mountains, palm trees, animals, and abstract shapes, all rendered with high-gloss, plastic-like textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Central character heads anchored to a central blue sphere
Floating 3D typography positioned above the main cluster
High-contrast relationship between bright, saturated objects and a deep black background
Radial distribution of secondary elements around the central globe
coreInvariants: Glossy, reflective surface finishes on all 3D objects
Star-field background with varying sizes of white sparkles
Playful, toy-like proportions for all organic and inorganic forms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large character heads dominate the lower-center foreground; a blue globe serves as the mid-ground base.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The two central heads with bold sunglasses provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central faces, moves upward to the large title text, then spirals outward to the smaller surrounding icons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black space filled with stars surrounds the central cluster, emphasizing the 'floating' effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and Sky Blue (globe and lettering)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red, Orange, and Green (accessories and foliage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all elements with bright specular highlights to simulate plastic materials.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high-key primary and secondary colors

letterConstructionRules: Letters are rendered as 3D inflatable objects
High-gloss, translucent blue material with internal refractions
Rounded, pillowy edges with visible 'seams' or creases like a balloon
Integration of character elements (e.g., ears) into specific letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Substitution of a letter with a fuzzy, textured animal head icon
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant 3D display style with no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the inflatable, toy-like aesthetic of the illustration.
Provides the necessary skeleton for 3D extrusion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 3D pop-surrealist scene on a black star-filled background. Center a blue globe with two cartoonish male heads wearing sunglasses in the foreground. Surround the globe with glossy 3D icons: mountains, palm trees, a dinosaur, a tiger, and a hot air balloon. Use a vibrant, high-saturation color palette with plastic-like textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, arched 3D inflatable lettering at the top. The letters should be glossy, translucent blue with a balloon-like volume. Replace one central letter with a fuzzy, golden-textured bunny head icon.

verificationChecks: Are all objects rendered with high-gloss 3D textures?
Is the background a deep black with white star sparkles?
Is the typography rendered as volumetric, inflatable shapes?
Are the two central heads the largest elements in the foreground?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent light source across all 3D elements
Ensure the text is legible despite the 3D distortion
Verify the star field does not overwhelm the central subject
Confirm the 'inflatable' look of the letters is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [3D Pop-Surrealism] with [Inflatable Typography] on a [Starry Void Background] using a [High-Gloss Plastic Texture] and [Vibrant Primary Colors].
